destinationsFound.name: Murudeshwara
destinationsFound.summary: 123-ft Shiva statue (among tallest in the world) on Kanduka Hill by the Arabian Sea; 20-storey Raja Gopuram (249 ft) with lift to viewpoint; Atmalinga/Ramayana-Ravana mythology; Bhukailasa Cave Museum beneath the statue; Murudeshwar Beach; Netrani Island scuba diving nearby (one of India's finest dive sites).
destinationsFound.timings: Temple 6:00 AM – 8:30 PM; morning darshan 6-1, evening 3-8:30; entry free; Raja Gopuram lift ~Rs 10-20.
destinationsFound.dressCode: Inner sanctum: men dhoti/formal trousers; women saree or chudidar with dupatta. No shorts/sleeveless/ripped jeans. Remove footwear.
destinationsFound.notes: Maha Shivaratri draws largest crowds. Photography free in outer complex, restricted in sanctum.

destinationsFound.name: Vijayapura (Bijapur) / Gol Gumbaz
destinationsFound.summary: Historic Adil Shahi capital (15th-17th c.) in north Karnataka, rich in Indo-Islamic architecture. Gol Gumbaz = tomb of Sultan Muhammad Adil Shah, second-largest dome in the world, with famous Whispering Gallery. Ibrahim Rauza (said to have inspired the Taj Mahal), Malik-e-Maidan (world's largest medieval cannon), Jama Masjid, Bijapur Fort, Chand Bawdi stepwell.
destinationsFound.howToReach: 530 km from Bengaluru via NH50/NH52; Vijayapura railway station (Mumbai-Hyderabad routes); nearest airports Belagavi (100 km), Hubballi (220 km).
destinationsFound.notes: Monuments close ~6 PM. Modest clothing at mosques/tombs. Local Bidri handicrafts. Name means 'City of Victory'.
